summary: All three previously identified gaps have been resolved: --demo-path is now wired into the CLI command and forwarded to collect_smoke_report, SMOKE_DEMO_PROJECT_MISSING is produced by the service when a project path does not resolve with an asserting test, and docs/PROJECT_ONBOARDING.md includes a DX smoke proof section referencing docs/SMOKE_COMMAND.md. The implementation fully achieves the plan: new files (smoke.py, test_smoke.py), modified files (main.py, README.md, PROJECT_ONBOARDING.md, TODO/), all seven phases with reason codes, mocked-local mode, and all specified tests exist and pass.
